location: Nauvis - New Dawn - Tar Processing Sector
summary: Today focused on stabilizing power and refining tar processing outputs.
I expanded the fish turbine array to a total of 54 units. This significantly improves passive power generation, especially during peak output cycles.
However, fish turbines are still inconsistent, so I will need to expand boilers and steam engines further to compensate when turbine output drops. That will be tomorrow’s task.
On the defensive side, I replaced two of the most frequently attacked perimeter sections with stone walls.
A new enemy type — small snappers — has become a concern. While they have less armor than armored biters, they deal significantly more damage and are capable of breaking wall segments during attacks.
Upgrading high-pressure areas to stone walls should reduce maintenance and improve overall durability.
On the production side, I set up additional processing to convert creosote and gasoline into aromatics. This helps relieve the creosote bottleneck and keeps tar processing flowing.
Despite that, gasoline and aromatics are still being overproduced.
Gasoline is actually a decent fuel source at 1.2 MJ per unit — far better than coal gas — while aromatics provide 350 kJ and can also be used as a mining fluid.
For now, I am storing excess aromatics and routing gasoline into glassworks to burn it off and prevent system backups.
On the research front, I continued focusing on quality-of-life upgrades.
I completed Basic Inventory Size 2, Basic Movement Speed 2, and Basic Reach Distance 2.
These upgrades further improve efficiency in construction, logistics, and general movement around the base.

status.power: Fish turbines expanded to 54 units; power improved but still requires steam backup expansion.
status.resource: Excess gasoline and aromatics accumulating; partial reuse implemented.
status.production: Tar processing stabilized further with creosote conversion; still overproducing some byproducts.
status.science: Additional quality-of-life upgrades completed for inventory, movement, and reach.
status.defense: Stone walls deployed in high-pressure zones; small snappers emerging as a new threat.
